narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Calling Card"**

The site is a calling card: small, exact, and taken in within a second. One centered column holds a name, four links, and a record of five roles. There is no prose, no imagery beyond employer marks, and no surface other than the page itself. Everything a visitor needs to judge Ali's path is in names, labels, and dates.

The mood is crisp and technical. Contrast is high, the palette is pure black and white with a short cool gray scale, and alignment is measured to the pixel. The one expressive note is the name, set in a pixel typeface that reads like an engineer's nameplate. The rest stays in a quiet geometric sans so the name carries the identity alone.

The layout follows andrewqu.com for spacing, type, and theming. None of its content is used.
keyCharacteristics: One 672px column, top-aligned, with fixed vertical rhythm (96, 64, 80, 24px).
Monochrome: white or black page, cool gray text, no accent color.
A pixel-font name as the single expressive element.
Equal care in light and dark themes.
Flat. No borders, cards, shadows, or separators.
Motion limited to 300ms color transitions and the theme switch.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no brand color. Hierarchy comes from the three gray steps and font weight, never from hue.

rules.name: The Three Steps Rule
rules.body: Text uses exactly three levels per theme: primary, secondary, muted. A new element takes one of them; it never introduces a fourth gray.

rules.name: The Nameplate Rule
rules.body: Geist Pixel Square belongs to the name. It may appear sparingly in a future section heading if the site grows, but never in body text, links, labels, or dates.

rules.name: The No Prose Rule
rules.body: Type sizes stop at 16px below the name because there is nothing longer than a role title to set. Do not add a size for paragraphs.

rules.name: The No Overflow Rule
rules.body: The page never scrolls horizontally, from 320px to 1440px.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits on a surface. If an element seems to need a card or divider, remove it or use spacing instead.

dos: Do keep every text color to the three steps: Ink/Frost, Slate/Steel, Ash.
Do keep the 96 / 64 / 80 / 24px rhythm and 48px rows when adding anything.
Do check both themes at 320, 390, 768, and 1440px for every change.
Do keep logos grayscale and tune brightness per mark so they read at a similar weight.
Do keep the visible focus outline on every interactive element.
donts: Don't add an accent color, gradient, glow, or shadow.
Don't add cards, borders, separators, pills, or background tints.
Don't use Geist Pixel Square outside the name, except sparingly for a future section heading.
Don't animate the name or add load, scroll, or hover motion beyond 300ms color changes.
Don't add paragraphs, taglines, or helper text to the page.
